procedure_column: Mittlefehldt 2024 Appendix A Pallasite olivine Spot analysis ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS Johnson Space Center

Laboratory.cell: ICP-MS Laboratory, NASA Johnson Space Center, Houston TX, USA
Laboratory.value: ICP-MS Laboratory, NASA Johnson Space Center, Houston TX, USA

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Mittlefehldt (2024) GCA; Lee (Rice University) Excel data reduction spreadsheet
Procedure Reference(s).value: Mittlefehldt (2024) GCA; Lee (Rice University) Excel data reduction spreadsheet

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain (olivine grain fragment) > Spot — "The laser was run in spot mode with a 75 µm spot size" (p.5); results are reported as average analyses per sample, and individual spots carry labels such as "laser spot 059-Pa-1" (p.8). Line scans across grain fragments were also run (p.3)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Olivine grain fragments repeatedly washed in dilute HCl and triply distilled H₂O, hand-picked, polished grain mounts
Sample Preparation Method.value: Olivine grain fragments repeatedly washed in dilute HCl and triply distilled H₂O, hand-picked, polished grain mounts

Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.cell: N — grains imaged by SEM to locate inclusion-free regions

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Freedom from inclusions, checked by SEM beforehand — the grains were "low in inclusions, [but] were not devoid of them", so "The grains were first imaged using a scanning electron microscope (SEM) to locate regions for analysis. Regions containing surface inclusions were avoided for analysis" (p.5)
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Freedom from inclusions, checked by SEM beforehand

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: SEM imaging of the grain mounts, used to place the spots — "The grains were first imaged using a scanning electron microscope (SEM) to locate regions for analysis. Regions containing surface inclusions were avoided for analysis" (p.5); the grains are the same mounts already used for EMPA (p.5)
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: SEM imaging of the grain mounts, used to place the spots

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: New Wave UP-193 solid state laser — §3.3
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: New Wave UP-193 solid state laser

Data Processing Software(s).cell: Excel spreadsheets developed by C.-T. A. Lee (Rice University)
Data Processing Software(s).value: Excel spreadsheets developed by C.-T. A. Lee (Rice University)

Laser Spot Path / Ablation Mode.cell: all: spot mode — 'The laser was run in spot mode' (§3.3)

Analysis Sequence.cell: N — the Marjalahti control belongs to the EMPA work (§3.1)

Target Species.cell: Mg, Al, P, Ca, Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Co, Ni, Zn, Ga — the elements of the 19 nuclides measured (§3.3)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: ²⁵Mg → Mg; ²⁷Al → Al; ³¹P → P; ⁴³Ca → Ca; ⁴⁴Ca → Ca; ⁴⁵Sc → Sc; ⁴⁷Ti → Ti; ⁴⁹Ti → Ti; ⁵¹V → V; ⁵²Cr → Cr; ⁵³Cr → Cr; ⁵⁹Co → Co; ⁶⁰Ni → Ni; ⁶¹Ni → Ni; ⁶²Ni → Ni; ⁶⁴Zn → Zn; ⁶⁶Zn → Zn; ⁶⁹Ga → Ga; ⁷¹Ga → Ga — 'The nuclides measured were 25Mg, 27Al, 31P, 43Ca, 44Ca, 45Sc, 47Ti, 49Ti, 51V, 52Cr, 53Cr, 59Co, 60Ni, 61Ni, 62Ni, 64Zn, 66Zn, 69Ga and 71Ga' (§3.3)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Mg, Al, P, Ca, Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Co, Ni, Zn, Ga (µg/g) — olivine trace element contents, individual data in Table L1, averages per sample split in Table L2 and per meteorite in Table L3 (§4)

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: N — the files documenting the analysis parameters 'were lost' (§3.3)

Background Count Time.cell: N — the analysis parameters were lost (§3.3)

Number of Replicates.cell: N — variable number of spots per sample

Internal Standard Approach.cell: all: single element, its concentration from EMPA — '25Mg was used as the indexing element for quantification with the EMPA data used as the standardizing values' (§3.3)

value.value: single element, its concentration from EMPA

Signal Integration Interval Method.cell: Time steps with enhanced count rates from inclusions or heterogeneity excluded — 'Analysis time steps that had enhanced count rates due to inclusions or heterogeneity were excluded from the data reduction'; inclusions show as 'time steps with enhanced P, Ca, Co, Ni and/or Zn count rates' (§3.3)
Signal Integration Interval Method.value: Time steps with enhanced count rates from inclusions or heterogeneity excluded

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Time steps with enhanced count rates from inclusions or heterogeneity excluded from the data reduction — §3.3
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Time steps with enhanced count rates from inclusions or heterogeneity excluded from the data reduction

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: N — the analysis parameters were lost (§3.3)

Interference Correction Method.cell: N — medium mass resolution (m/Δm of 4000) was used; its purpose is not stated (§3.3)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — the reported values are averages per meteorite (Table E4 of the data file), with the complete set of analyses also released (p.6); trace-element chromatograms were "scrutinized for unanticipated interferences, improperly chosen backgrounds or other problems" (p.5). No acceptance or rejection rule is stated for the LA data. The paper's detailed filters — analysis sums 100 ± 2%, stoichiometry limits, Grubb's test rejecting at p<0.01 and tagging at p<0.05, an FeO ceiling of 17.5 wt% for Phillips County, and a zoning profile excluded from that mean — are stated for the EMPA data (p.3) and are not borrowed here

Combination Method.cell: all: average per sample split, and weighted mean per meteorite — 'data averaged per sample split' (Table L2), 'meteorite averages' (Table L3); 'Because a weighted mean is calculated for the data' (§6.1)

value.value: average per sample split, and weighted mean per meteorite

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [all: USGS glasses BCR-2g, BHVO-2g and BIR-1g] — 'Preferred values from the GeoReM website ... were used to define the calibration lines' (§3.3)

value.value: USGS glasses BCR-2g, BHVO-2g and BIR-1g

Detection Limit.cell: N — LODs not stated; concentrations reported for all nuclides above background

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property
Counting Statistics Error.cell: N — the ~0.6% precision on Fe/Mn is for the EMPA (§3.1)

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: N — within-session precision not formally assessed

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: N — LA-ICP-MS Sc agrees with INAA 'with scatter of roughly ±0.5 µg/g'; Cr scatters more (§6.1)

Additional Notes.cell: The files documenting the analysis parameters (gas flows, laser power, etc.) were lost during an extended shutdown of the JSC ICP-MS laboratory; the grains are the EMPA grain mounts, 'low in inclusions, [but] not devoid of them' (§3.3)
